scope: Listed cash-equity executions captured before allocation; identifiers and values in fixtures are synthetic.

owners.support: Resolve the Trading Support service record before activation

bindings.schemaSelection: Pinned release; resolve registry ID separately in each environment
bindings.keyEncoding: Canonical compact JSON array of producer_id and execution_id, UTF-8

semantics.grain: One immutable reported revision of one logical execution

time.received_at: Adapter's first receipt of this report
time.emitted_at: Canonical event emission; all timestamps are UTC

semantics.corrections: NEW creates revision 1. CORRECT is a complete replacement image. BUST sets the execution inactive. CORRECT/BUST require the previous event ID and next revision. Never sum correction quantities as new fills.
semantics.allocation: Fund/book allocation is a separate contract; do not fabricate it when a raw fill arrives.
semantics.ordering: By execution key, not globally. Native reports must be durably mapped to this revision chain by the adapter.

quality.onFailure: Preserve raw report, hold affected canonical execution, open an owned incident and expose downstream completeness; never silently discard a fill.

service.activationGate: Assign actual service owners, measured SLOs, clock-skew policy, retention, consumer acknowledgements and recovery evidence before activation.

consumers.acceptance: Original, duplicate, correction, bust and out-of-order replay yield the same position as reconciled source state.
Use original execution time and correct economic image; reconcile output coverage to executions.
